issues.desc: background.md uses "P3" multiple times (Trigger Event, Conversational Texture) and the checklist uses "the P3 class" (CHK-002 context) without ever defining or expanding the term. A standalone reader cannot determine whether P3 refers to a plan phase, priority tier, or project label.

background.md Key Insights section claims audit-scan.ts is "currently consumed only by handlers/audit.ts", but packages/main/src/tasks/audit-esm-smoke.ts also imports from it (import { runMechanicalAudit } from ../core/audit-scan.js). The existing-system claim is factually inaccurate.
